title: Join our June 29th, 2026, virtual roundtable with the NIH’s All of Us Research Program
summary: Study diabetes at scale using genomic, EHR, survey, and wearable data from 633,000+ All of Us participants.
bodyHtml:
Using Large-Scale Data to Advance Your Diabetes Research

Monday, June 29th, 2026
1:00–2:00 p.m. ET 

Hear from researchers using All of Us data:

  • Satoshi Yoshiji, MD, PhD, Assistant Professor, McGill University and Visiting Scholar,
    Broad Institute
  • Julie Jurgens, PhD, Scientific Communications and Curation Manager, Knowledge
    Portals, Broad Institutes

Why attend?

  • Use All of Us data (633+ participants) to study diabetes at scale
  • Explore real-world evidence, genomics, and longitudinal data
  • Share your perspectives

Register for the event
